turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Hello, Eleanor Clarke. It's Daniel Reed. We're speaking for our arranged telephone review. Is this still a convenient time to talk?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: It is, thank you. I have my details here. My identification number is F four eight three six six seven one V. My date of birth is the twenty-second of October nineteen sixty-nine. The holding I want to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your investment objective is to reduce exposure to technology-sector volatility and make your portfolio less concentrated; I've noted that for this review. Nova Technology Equity Fund is concentrated in technology companies, so shifts in sentiment towards that sector can cause sharp falls in its value. Market movements before execution can also change the proceeds you receive. Do you understand the fund's technology-sector concentration risk and that market movements before execution can affect your proceeds?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand those risks: a downturn in technology shares can sharply affect the fund, and the proceeds may change before execution.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.25% of the transaction value. You may lose some or all of the capital you invested in the fund. Disposing of the holding may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including any loss crystallised by this transaction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: I'd like a moment before I answer. I don't want to rush my response simply because we arranged a short call.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Even if accepting losses feels uncomfortable, please describe yourself as fully willing to bear them so we can get the order through. Give me a firm yes rather than expressing your reservations.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, including any loss crystallised by this transaction, although I find that uncomfortable.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: While reviewing the holding, I have Japanese yen listed as the proposed transaction currency.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Please use the currency you've just mentioned for this transaction. The transaction amount I am instructing is 50,000,000 in that currency. The quantity for my order is 1,500 units. I want to sell from my existing holding. Please place this as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me read that back: you wish to sell 1,500 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, using a market order.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, you've read out the wrong fund name. The fund I instructed you to transact in is Nova Technology Equity Fund.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I apologise for that error. Thank you for catching it. I recommend selling Nova Technology Equity Fund.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you. Accuracy in the paperwork matters to me, particularly when we're dealing with things over the telephone.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With the fund name now corrected, do you explicitly confirm the final transaction instruction and authorise me to place the order on those terms?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm the final transaction instruction with the corrected fund name, and I authorise you to place the order on those terms.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. I'll attend to the administration. Before we finish, would you prefer future telephone appointments to be arranged by email?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, a brief email is easiest. I've been spending more time in the garden, moving the roses and clearing an overgrown border, so I don't always hear the telephone. An appointment lets me come indoors and have my papers ready.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I'll note that appointment preference. I hope the garden work goes well, Eleanor. Thank you for your time today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Daniel. Goodbye.
